class.name: GameNetworkDiagnostics
class.brief_description: A local snapshot of a game's connection and movement.
class.description: Read a snapshot through [method Game.network_diagnostics] for a developer panel or test. The properties describe the session at the time of the call. They do not control the transport or movement simulation. Only ENet provides a round-trip estimate in this snapshot.

members.member: The local session role when sampled.
[code]enet[/code] for ENet, [code]custom[/code] for other multiplayer peers, or empty when idle or offline.
The local session peer ID, or zero before admission.
The local actor's one-based fixed-world spawn slot. Returns zero while no local actor is mounted, including on a dedicated server. This is a session placement, separate from the transport's peer ID.
The number of admitted remote peers visible to the local game session.
The ENet round-trip estimate in milliseconds. A guest reports the server link. A server reports the highest guest estimate. A value of -1 means that an ENet measurement is unavailable.
The last known completed server physics tick, or zero when unavailable.
The last local guest input sequence accounted for by server state, or zero when unavailable.
The number of local guest commands awaiting confirmation.
The number of owner corrections above the simulation's visible-error threshold during the current session.
The most recent owner correction in metres, or zero before a correction.
The latest authoritative local actor position. If there is no local actor, the origin vector is returned.
The current predicted local actor position when [member movement_mode] is [constant GUEST_PREDICTED].
Local elapsed milliseconds since the most recent authoritative guest state arrived, or -1 when unavailable.
The number of inputs replayed during the most recent owner reconciliation.

constants.constant: The game owns no active connection.
The local player runs an offline session.
The game is running as a listen authority or coordinated server.
A guest connection is awaiting admission.
The local client has been admitted by the authority.
The fixed-world game is running as a dedicated server.
No fixed-world movement diagnostics are available.
The authority uses the live Godot movement driver.
The authority uses the grounded driver shared by prediction.
The owning guest follows authoritative position updates.
The owning guest predicts and reconciles local movement.
